$comment: GA4 event-scoped custom dimensions, one per event parameter the apps send.
GA4 COLLECTS unregistered parameters but cannot REPORT on them: until a
parameter is registered here it is invisible in explorations and audiences.
parameterName must match the event param in the code EXACTLY, and both it and
`scope` are immutable once created — only displayName/description can change.
GA4 limits: parameterName 40 chars, displayName 82, description 150. The long
reasoning lives in `rationale`, which stays in the repo and is never sent.
GA4 allows 50 event-scoped custom dimensions per property.
Numeric params (duration_seconds, count) belong in custom METRICS, not here.

dimensions.description: First-touch source on sign_up (?source / ?utm_source / ?ref), or 'organic'. Attributes registrations to campaigns.
dimensions.rationale: GA4's own attribution only understands utm_*, so a visitor arriving with a bare ?source=reddit looks organic to it. Sending the captured first-touch value as an event parameter is the only way 'registrations by campaign' is answerable. Set in client/src/scripts/analytics.ts (trackAuthSuccess), captured by auth.captureAcquisitionSource().

dimensions.description: Auth provider on sign_up and login (currently always 'google'), and the join path on room_joined.
dimensions.rationale: GA4 treats `method` as a recommended parameter for sign_up/login but still will not report on it until it is registered.

dimensions.description: Whether a started call was created public (listed on the home) or private (link only). Sent on start_call.
dimensions.rationale: Separates the growth loop (public rooms, discoverable) from private usage — they convert differently and should never be read as one number.

dimensions.description: Whether the person joining a room was already a signed-in account holder. Sent on room_joined.
dimensions.rationale: Distinguishes first-time guests from account holders in the same funnel step, which is what makes room_joined interpretable.

dimensions.description: Why a call could not start — room_full, banned, credits_exhausted. Sent on call_failed and limit_reached.
dimensions.rationale: Without it the funnel drop-off is a single unexplained number; with it, credits_exhausted (a pricing signal) is separable from room_full (a capacity signal).

dimensions.description: Which call-to-action was clicked on the marketing site. Sent on cta_clicked (website).
dimensions.rationale: Pairs with `location` to tell which CTA copy works, independently of where it sits on the page.

dimensions.description: Where on the page the clicked call-to-action sits (hero, pricing, footer…). Sent on cta_clicked (website).
dimensions.rationale: Pairs with `button`: the same label converts very differently in the hero and in the footer.
